landing.title: Know where you stand. Know what's missing. Know your next step.
landing.subtitle: HerPath checks Pakistani and foreign scholarships against your profile, shows exactly which requirements you meet, and gives you a dated plan for the rest.
landing.free: Free. No documents uploaded. Built for girls in Pakistan.
steps: Tell us about you in about 3 minutes
See what you meet and what's missing
Fix each gap with a step-by-step guide
landing.numbers: {total} scholarships to check today: {pk} in Pakistan and {abroad} abroad, {full} of them fully funded.
landing.exampleLead: Every scholarship is checked requirement by requirement. This is what a graduate with a 2-year BA sees for Fulbright.

example.name: Fulbright Master's (USA)
example.r3: 16 years of education needed. You have 14.
example.f3: Fix: complete a BS or a 2-year Master's first.
example.f4: Fix: free GRE preparation guide. Start by 15 January.
example.r5: Willing to return to Pakistan after study

landing.legendTitle: Every requirement gets one of four answers

legend.fixable: You can fix it before the deadline.
legend.later: You can fix it, but for the next cycle.
legend.no: A fixed rule you can't change, said plainly.

landing.familyTitle: A page your parents can read in Urdu
landing.familyText: One tap makes a simple page for your family: what the scholarship pays for in rupees, that applying is free, who runs it, and where you would live. Share it on WhatsApp.
landing.teacherText: Sit with a student, fill her profile in a few minutes on your phone, and send her results on WhatsApp. Our guides cover income certificates, domicile, HEC attestation, passports and more.

promise.free: Free, always. No one pays to find or apply.
promise.rules: No AI. Clear rules you can read on every page.
promise.docs: No documents uploaded. Only a yes or no for each one.
promise.verified: Every listing links to its official source and shows when it was last checked.

landing.finalTitle: Your first step takes three minutes
landing.finalText: Create a free account, answer a few questions, and see which scholarships you can apply for.
